premises.text: Traffic navigation apps rely on pre-computed routes that do not account for real-time traffic changes
premises.evidence_span: they take a big shortcut. They pre-compute some routes for that time of day in advance, and they store them in a database, so they can return a result quickly.

premises.text: More accurate traffic data sources exist beyond mobile apps, such as loop detectors and traffic cameras
premises.evidence_span: there are much more accurate sources of traffic data besides phones, like loop detectors and traffic cameras

premises.text: TallyGo provides time-dependent routing based on minute-level traffic data
premises.evidence_span: we built the first-ever intelligent routing layer for minute-level data

premises.text: Businesses currently lack a real-time, turn-by-turn navigation solution embedded in their apps
premises.evidence_span: embeddable navigation simply doesn't exist today

premises.text: TallyGo's SDK allows companies to integrate real-time navigation easily into their existing applications
premises.evidence_span: With TallyGo's navigation SDK, for the very first time, any company can embed real-time, turn-by-turn navigation directly into their existing apps

value.text: Businesses can improve operational efficiency and reduce costs through integrated real-time navigation
value.evidence_span: they would be printing money, and so would Uber

notes: Examples of poor navigation options and the demo with the fire department illustrate the need for TallyGo's solution.
